name: Resilient
summary: +1 to an ability whose saving throw you lack, and gain proficiency in that saving throw.

benefits.name: Saving Throw Proficiency
benefits.summary: Gain saving throw proficiency with the ability this feat increased.
benefits.text: Choose an ability in which you lack saving throw proficiency; this feat's Ability Score Increase must go to that ability (+1, to a maximum of 20). You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.
